preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_attempt WHERE status NOT IN ('RUNNING', 'SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'BLOCKED')
SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_result WHERE status NOT IN ('CREATED', 'UPDATED', 'SKIPPED', 'FAILED', 'BLOCKED')

changeSet.comment: Extend the canonical apply attempt/result ledger for accepted merge checkpoints and forward undo. Legacy results intentionally retain NULL checkpoints, which makes re-import and undo fail closed until a new accepted apply establishes revision pins.
